title: GitHub Release Status Mix
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:release
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(release_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the GitHub release feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `release_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your GitHub release feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
